shots.focal_element: Brand Radar overview metric cards (Search demand 2.4M, Web visibility 3.6M), then the Search queries and Web pages reports
shots.transition_other: Not visible in this packet (sheet starts mid-shot already in a tilted UI close-up); anchors classify it as other.
shots.typography: Real product UI in a neutral grotesque sans (Inter-like, low-confidence guess): small sentence-case regular card labels, large regular-weight metric numerals, small grey sub-labels; dense small table text with yellow keyword highlights on the brand name; normal tracking.
shots.what_happens: A long multi-beat UI walkthrough on a slightly tilted, drifting camera: the overview metric row slides in, an orange-to-yellow outline traces around the Search demand card as w259-w260 'Search demand' is spoken; it cuts in-shot to the Search queries table whose query column fills with a yellow highlight (~w271-w279); then back to the cards where the Web visibility card gets the same outline (w281-w282); then the Web pages report appears and the camera pushes in and slowly scrolls the result list, Ahrefs mentions highlighted in yellow, under w290-w304.

shots.build_rebuild: Hold a flat full-frame screenshot of the Web pages report for ~1.25 s with at most a subtle scale drift, as a breather before the next section.

shots.focal_element: Left sidebar nav (SERP visibility, Search demand, Web visibility > Web pages) beside the first Web pages results

shots.focal_element: The app window shrinking onto a blue-purple gradient backdrop with the labels Wikipedia, YouTube, Reddit below it

shots.build_rebuild: Scale the full-frame screenshot down to ~65% with a slight 3D tilt over ~0.9 s to reveal a dark blue-violet gradient background, then fade/rise in three white source labels in a row beneath the window.
